summary: Workspace setup ran secrets:pull through a Turborepo task, the pull exited 1 because Infisical was not logged in, and local-files then exited 1 after printing that it would continue. The orchestrator reported setup unfinished and the workspace never reached dev. Start is only run.sh: a cold run prepares once, records .cache/workspace-warm even when the pull fails, launches dev, and a later run skips preparation.
